ChanChan Noodle Vegan house
Jul 2026 • Friends
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an amazing dining experience at ChanChan Vegan Noodle. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. Even though everything is plant-based, every dish was packed with flavor and left me completely satisfied.

What impressed me the most was the service. The staff were genuinely warm, attentive, and happy to explain the menu and recommend their signature dishes. They made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in.

The restaurant itself has a unique retro Hong Kong-inspired atmosphere that is stylish, cozy, and perfect for both casual lunches and dinner with friends. Every corner is thoughtfully designed and great for photos.

If you’re visiting Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend adding ChanChan to your food list—even if you’re not vegan.

⭐ Branch 1: 25A Ngo Quang Huy, An Khanh, Ho Chi Minh City
⭐ Branch 2: 5 Ngo Van Nam, Saigon Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

I will definitely come back!

A Wonderful Family Dining Experience at a Vegetarian Restaurant
Jun 2026 • Family
Last weekend, I went to a vegetarian restaurant with my family, and we had a wonderful time together. The restaurant had a warm and relaxing atmosphere, which made our meal even more enjoyable.
The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. We ordered several different dishes, and every one of them was full of flavor. The staff were friendly, polite, and always ready to help.
My family and I were very impressed with both the food and the excellent service. I highly recommend this vegetarian restaurant to anyone who wants to enjoy a healthy and tasty meal with their loved ones. We will definitely visit again in the future.
